Ultra-light Day Fluid SPF 50 with Collagen Elastin Complex and Thiamidol. 

Anti-aging day fluid for skin that shows premature signs of aging. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Ultra-light Day SPF 50 is an anti-aging day fluid that improves skin’s elasticity and corrects all types of dark spots*. The unique formula delivers multiple anti-aging benefits. The Collagen-Elastin Complex, a powerful combination of Hyaluronic Acid and Creatine, re-energizes collagen production and increases skin’s elasticity. Eucerin’s patented Thiamidol reduces the appearance of dark spots and their reappearition. For skin that is smoother, more radiant, and visibly younger looking. The ultra-light day fluid also contains an imperceptible SPF 50 and a UVA filter to effectively prevent UV-induced premature skin aging and deepening of wrinkles.

Whether your main concern is loss of elasticity and dark spots, this Eucerin Anti-Age Ultra-light SPF 50 Day Fluid adapts to your skincare needs. 

The fluid has an ultra-light sensation and gives an immediate fresh complexion. It is non-sticky & non-greasy and can therefore be used as an excellent make-up base. The formula is non-comedogenic. 

*Due to sunlight exposure, hormonal influences, acne & aging.

How to Use

Apply in the morning on a well-cleansed face, neck and décolleté. Gently massage into skin. Avoid contact with eyes. Maximum of four applications of all face products containing Thiamidol per day. For best results, use in combination with other products in the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range.

Thiamidol

Thiamidol is a patented ingredient, known to fight hyperpigmentation acting at its root cause. It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:

Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.

Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.

Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.

FAQ

When should I use the Hyaluron-Filler Ultra-light Day SPF 50?

The Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Ultra-light Day SPF 50 can be used in the morning on the face, neck and décolleté. Due to his Ultra-light texture, it can be used as an excellent make-up base which gives an immediate fresh complexion. The formula is non-sticky and non-greasy. The imperceptible SPF 50 protects your skin against UVA and UVB and therefore protects your skin from photoageing and collagen loss.

If your skin needs intense moisture and a caring day cream with UVA protection to effectively help prevent UV-induced premature skin aging and the deepening of wrinkles, we recommend using Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day SPF 30.

How to use the twist-up dispenser?

The twist up dispenser is a mechanism suitable to facilitate light textures application. Rotate to the right to open the twist up dispenser. Push 1 to 2 times to release the product.

Is the Hyaluron-Filler ultra-light day SPF 50 suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes, the Hyaluron-Filler Ultra-light Day SPF 50 is clinically and dermatologically tested and proven for all skin type, including sensitive skin.

What benefits can I expect from using an ultra-light protecting fluid?

An ultra-light SPF 50 day fluid gives the skin more elasticity, reduces and prevents dark spots. It reveals a youthful skin complexion, with an ultra-light sensation due to the imperceptible high SPF.

At what age should I start using Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity?

Our skin is as different as we are, so the answer to that question varies from person to person and depends on many factors both internal (such as our genetics) and external (such as the amount of sun our skin has been exposed to). As a general rule, the first signs of aging such as fine lines and wrinkles start to appear in our 30s and the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler range targets these concerns. It tends to be when we are 50 and over that skin elasticity needs the support that the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range offers.

If you are in any doubt please read our article on skin at different ages or consult a pharmacist or dermatologist.
